properties.popup_body:
Hurley Group is pleased to announce the opening of Wood Wharf Health Centre, only a 5 minute walk from Canary Wharf underground station and taking registrations for NHS patients.

The centre is a new branch of the existing Island Medical Centre, providing the full range of NHS GP services, and giving new and existing patients improved quality of care, and accessibility at both locations.

The centre offers face-to-face, telephone, and digital eConsult consultations for registered patients, as well as high clinical standards at the brand new state-of-the-art location.

Wood Wharf Health Centre is now open for new registrations via the website www.islandmedical.co.uk

properties.name: Canary Wharf Theatre
properties.popup_body:
Opening soon..........

The premiere of the first-ever theatre adaptation of Suzanne Collins’ internationally acclaimed book and Lionsgate’s motion-picture, The Hunger Games: On Stage comes to Canary Wharf in 2025. The theatrical event of the year will be performed in a brand-new state of the art venue, Troubadour Canary Wharf Theatre, located in the heart of Wood Wharf. 

Based on the original “Hunger Games” story, this gripping tale of courage, defiance and unbreakable human spirit, follows the fearless heroine Katniss Everdeen on her journey of self-discovery, as she emerges as a beacon of rebellion and hope.

Multi award-winning playwright Conor McPherson (Girl from the North Country, The Weir) and Director Matthew Dunster (2:22 – A Ghost Story, Hangmen, The Pillowman), will bring this powerful story to life on stage, using extraordinary stunts and illusions in an epic, unforgettable, theatrical experience.

properties.name: Locke London Canary Wharf
properties.popup_body:
opening soon......

Located on the waterfront, Locke London Canary Wharf brings together mid-century-inspired design, vibrant social spaces, and panoramic views of the London skyline. Inspired by the iconic architecture that defines Canary Wharf, the property spans 19 floors, with 279 rooms bursting with characterful design that has become singularly synonymous with Locke. The property’s stand-out feature is Locke’s very first rooftop restaurant and bar, opening later in the year and situated on the 19th floor. In the ground floor communal space, guests and locals can enjoy a range of coffees and treats, served all day at the on-site café, as well as drinks in the evening. Other features include a gym and meeting space.

properties.popup_body:
Whether you’re looking for a change of scenery for a work trip, a weekend getaway, or a longer city break, an exciting new offering awaits in East London. Seeking a flexible stay? Feel at ease and enjoy the services of a hotel with the comforts of home with Vertus Edit – your ideal aparthotel in the heart of Wood Wharf at Canary Wharf.

Vertus Edit’s aparthotel blurs the boundaries of an apartment and traditional hotel set-up, offering guests a more flexible stay with extra space to do more than just make a cup of coffee. With a selection of studio layouts to choose from, it’s easy to find the perfect fit for you. Each comes kitted out with all the essentials, plus a few unexpected perks, to ensure your stay is seamless and enjoyable. No matter which you pick, you can unpack and unwind in cosy studios, where you’re guaranteed a good night’s sleep in a comfy double bed.
